english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a coffin or burial box.

examples.english: After the old man died, his family prepared a coffin for him.
examples.traditional: 老人家過身之後，屋企人幫佢準備咗副棺材。
examples.jyutping: lou5 jan4 gaa1 gwo3 san1 zi1 hau6 uk1 kei2 jan4 bong1 keoi5 zeon2 bei6 zo2 fu3 gun1 coi4
